title: Fix Flow Slider Knob Zoom Scaling
description: flow: There is a bug that the slider knob is not scaling with the zoom level as the other elements are. Fix so the slider knob scales with canvas zoom like the track and other node elements.
summary: Fixed flow graph slider knob not scaling with zoom: GraphSliderOverlays now lays out in world units and applies translate(-50%,-50%) scale(zoom), so thumb and track CSS tokens scale with the canvas like other node elements. Extended renderer vitest; focused graph-slider tests pass.
